description: The Mzizi brand system: 21 colour families (7 minerals, 7 heritage, 7 experimental), semantic colours, typography, spacing, radii and the ecosystem brands. Ask for `colors` to get every colour family in one call. For text, use each family's `textLight` / `textDark` on the base surface, and `onContainerLight` / `onContainerDark` on its container; never use `hex`, `lightHex` or `darkHex` as a text colour (they are accents).

family.description: One of: colors (all 21 colour families at once), minerals, heritage, experimental, semantic, backgrounds, typography, spacing, radii, ecosystem, componentSpecs, accessibility, voiceAndTone, philosophy. Common aliases resolve (status/semanticColors, radius, type/fonts, exp). Omit for everything.
